title: Loudness Meter
text: Standard-compliant loudness measurements, 1 input, 3 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Channel weights} sets the linear weighting applied to each input channel, {Use relative scale for loudness measurements} sets the block to output loudness measurements relative to target, {Target loudness level (LUFS)} sets the reference level for relative loudness measurements, {Output true-peak value} adds output port for true-peak value, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Channel weights
params.values: Linear weighting applied to each input channel [1, 1, 1, 1.41, 1.41] (default) | nonnegative row vector

params.name: Use relative scale for loudness measurements
params.values: Specify block to output loudness measurements relative to target level off (default) | on

params.name: Target loudness level (LUFS)
params.values: Reference level for relative loudness measurements –23 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Output true-peak value
params.values: Add output port for true-peak value off (default) | on

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
